package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type ContextMutationHandler struct {
	Mutations repository.TeacherContextMutationStore
	Clock     Clock
}

// Handle durably receipts the Dialog mutation and invalidates an intersecting
// scoped summary. It never fetches Dialog history or message content.
func (handler ContextMutationHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, raw domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) (bool, error) {
	mutation, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if handler.Mutations == nil || handler.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("teacher context mutation dependencies are required")
	}
	processedAt := handler.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if processedAt.IsZero() {
		return false, domain.ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation
	}
	result, err := handler.Mutations.ApplyMutation(ctx, mutation, processedAt)
	return result.Processed, err
}
